purpose: Pre-freeze premise audit. Run BEFORE the protocol freeze because a premise discovered missing afterwards forces an unplanned deviation or a second freeze. Every load-bearing premise is recorded with evidence matched to its TYPE; a physical premise that cannot be tested with available data is marked OPEN-AND-SCOPED, never forced into a repository test that would merely restate the model.

premises.premise: the semi-discrete system is LINEAR in the state, so expm and the A0+kA1 pencil are valid
premises.failure_consequence: the exact-in-time reference and the analytical limit are both invalid

premises.premise: A(kappa) = A0 + kappa*A1 with A1 carrying the interphase transfer terms
premises.evidence: verified structurally: |(A(3)-A(1))/2 - (A(2)-A(1))| / scale = 2.8e-14, and 2.1e-14 at kappa=100. A1 has rank 400 and nullity 201 on the 601-state operator (2x200 grain-transfer rows fast; 200 liquid + 1 accumulation slow), matching the structure the limit argument assumes.
premises.failure_consequence: the analytical limit construction has no basis and P0-G8 cannot run as specified

premises.premise: for each fixed T > 0 the stable null-basis endpoint IS the large-kappa limit of exp((A0 + kappa A1)T) z0, and the assumptions of that proposition hold at every declared cell
premises.evidence: FORMAL. The fixed-positive-time singular limit is proved in PAPER_A_FIXED_TIME_SINGULAR_LIMIT_PROPOSITION.md (semisimple zero of A1; strictly stable nonzero spectrum; Lyapunov bound ||exp((kappa F + A_ff)t)|| <= M exp(-gamma kappa t) with M, gamma, kappa_0 DERIVED from the operator, not fitted; Gronwall on the slow block). The quantitative statement is HOMOGENEOUS in the initial state: ||r_kappa(T)|| <= (C_T/kappa)||z0|| + M_T exp(-gamma kappa T)||Q z0||, with C_T and M_T independent of z0. Its assumptions are verified at all 27 operator-distinct cells covering all 54 declared cells: semisimplicity VERIFIED AT THE DECLARED STRUCTURAL CUT (expected_fast_rank = 2*nz = 400, expected_slow_nullity = nz+1 = 201), with separations 1.9e13 and 5.3e13 and agreement across the structural rank, the SVD null-basis rank and the ordered-Schur fast-mode count; every fast eigenvalue strictly stable (worst max Re = -1.218); projector identities <= 1e-13; cond(L) <= 2.13; dual-basis cross-check < 1e-9; endpoint finite, real and strictly positive everywhere; the output COVECTOR annihilates the fast subspace (e_out Q = 0). Uniform convergence at t = 0 is explicitly REJECTED for off-manifold initial data. The high-kappa sequence is retained as a DIAGNOSTIC only and proves nothing; it is method_limited, which does not block.
premises.failure_consequence: the endpoint classification has no trustworthy f_inf, and the eventual-upper reading loses its premise
premises.closure_rule: overall_PR03a_status = assured iff algebraic_limit_status = assured and endpoint_construction_status = verified and coverage_status = complete and finite_kappa_validation_status != inconsistent
premises.assurance_basis_note: The prior disposition was also 'assured', but on numerical convergence of a finite high-kappa sequence. That is a diagnostic, not a proof. The basis is now a proved theorem with verified assumptions. Two defects in the first formal attempt were corrected after exact-head review: the quantitative bound was not homogeneous in z0, and the semisimplicity verifier inferred the rank from the globally largest SVD gap, which reports a scale-separated DEFECTIVE zero as semisimple. Both are recorded in PAPER_A_CLAIM_RESOLUTION_DELTA_PRE_FREEZE.json entries D-02 and D-03.

Under the WIDE-referenced endpoint architecture the threshold is referenced to J_ref on the resolved finite domain, so no sharp finite-tail bound is needed. tail_onset_status is unresolved_by_design. A future sharp derivation may only enter as a separately versioned pre-result amendment or as a supplemental study that cannot upgrade the frozen same-campaign primary claim; it must not be selected after seeing the endpoint classifications.
premises.failure_consequence: no numerical finite tail onset is reported; endpoint result unaffected

premises.premise: the MAPE level minimiser is the weighted median of y_i/f_i with weights f_i/y_i
premises.evidence: Proposition stated and property-tested against a direct convex reference: the minimiser set is the weighted-median interval and the objective is EXACTLY constant on it, so tie width is inventory-level information and cannot enter a J error budget. Also established that the minimiser is generically UNIQUE here, because w_i = 1/r_i couples weight to ratio; a tie needs n_a/r_a = n_b/r_b and is constructed explicitly. Continuity as f -> f_inf verified, which is what makes the endpoint comparison meaningful. 31 tests.
premises.failure_consequence: J(kappa) is optimiser-dependent and the exact profile claim is unsupported

reading: PR-03 is SPLIT per the adjudication. PR-03a is ASSURED ON A PROOF: the fixed-positive-time singular limit is proved, its assumptions are verified at all 27 operator-distinct cells covering all 54 declared cells, and the high-kappa sequence is demoted to a diagnostic. The P0-G8 endpoint classification has a trustworthy f_inf and no finite-kappa remainder belongs in its budget. Convergence is NOT uniform at t = 0 for off-manifold data and no such claim is made. PR-03b is NOT PURSUED under the current protocol: the WIDE-referenced architecture removes the need for a sharp finite-tail bound, and tail_onset_status is unresolved_by_design. PR-06 is assured. PR-09 and PR-15 are gate-scoped to P0-G9 and P0-G10. P0-G0 remains open because the Protocol V2 endpoint/tail split, PR-04, PR-07 staging and the PR-09 rule are not yet implemented.
